Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP com sólida experiência em extensões na SAP BTP, utilizando CAP e RAP, para atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções cloud nativas integradas a ambientes SAP (ECC/S/4HANA).

Vaga hibrida qualquer cidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações e extensões na SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Implementar APIs, serviços OData/REST, lógica de negócio e integrações com sistemas SAP on-premise e cloud.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de aplicações existentes, realizando correções, melhorias e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos).
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento utilizando CAP (Node.js/Java) e RAP (ABAP RESTful).
  • Bom domínio de ABAP OO, modelos de dados SAP, CDS Views, OData e conceitos de clean core.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de desenvolvimento moderno (code review, testes, pipelines básicos).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa comunicação em times distribuídos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Certificações SAP em BTP, CAP, RAP ou S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5, integrações com APIs externas e eventos (Event Mesh, Kafka, etc.).


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita

title: Desenvolvedor (a) React Native/ Release manager - SR
description:
Código da vaga: 55512


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Desenvolvedor (a) React Native/ Release manager - SR, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Buscamos um profissional para gerenciar as releases dos aplicativos mobile de um grande cliente, garantindo entregas estáveis, automatizadas e de alta qualidade nas lojas da Google Play e Apple App Store .

⚙️ Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o processo de build e publicação de aplicativos Android e iOS.
  • Controlar versionamento e merge de branches no Git.
  • Garantir o fluxo contínuo de entregas em ambientes mobile.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de desenvolvimento, QA e DevOps para garantir previsibilidade e qualidade nas releases.

✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência com React Native
  • Conhecimento prático do processo de build e publicação de aplicativos Android e iOS.
  • Domínio de Git , incluindo merge de branches e versionamento.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência com CI/CD , automação de builds e pipelines.
  • Conhecimento sobre versionamento semântico e boas práticas de entrega contínua.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento mobile (ex: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics).

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (Remote – Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote (Brazil) – São Paulo

Duration: Open-Ended


Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning solutions. In this role, you will influence the technical direction of the team, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners, and drive innovation across data-driven initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong technical expertise with leadership capabilities and a passion for building high-impact solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end development and deployment of Machine Learning models to solve complex business problems.
  • Write and maintain clean, efficient, scalable code following industry best practices.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and support data-informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies, including deep learning and modern frameworks, to build robust models.
  • Take ownership of key system components and influence the broader technical strategy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to design deployable, production-ready ML solutions.
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, fostering team expertise and growth.
  • Contribute to organizational technical leadership through patent filings and publications in top-tier venues.


Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML and deep learning models in production at scale.
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, pipelines, feature engineering, experiment design).
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and techniques such as gradient boosting, deep neural networks, transformers, and optimization methods.
  • Experience in Computer Vision ; experience in Causal Inference is highly desirable.
  • Expertise with Python scientific libraries (NumPy, pandas, Polars) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn).
  • Strong data engineering skills and comfort working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark).
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python and SQL .


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related fields.
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail industry problems.
  • Familiarity with modern MLOps tools and pipelines .
  • Impact-driven mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience guiding or managing technical teams.

title: VENDEDOR EXTERNO JR
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A VITAFOR é uma das maiores empresas de suplementos alimentares do Brasil.


Desde o início trabalhamos para promover a saúde através da nutrição, mostrando que a suplementação é fundamental para o bem-estar humano.


Hoje, temos orgulho de ser “a marca mais premiada pelos profissionais da saúde e nutrição do país”, acumulando diferentes prêmios para o segmento.


Nossa fábrica, localizada na cidade de Araçoiaba da Serra – SP, é a maior e mais moderna do segmento, com laboratório de análises próprio, certificações nacionais e internacionais, além de boas práticas ambientais.


Responsabilidades:

Experiência anterior com vendas em PDVs, preferencialmente em farmácias, lojas de suplementos ou produtos naturais;

Habilidade em negociação e gestão de objeções, com foco em conversão e relacionamento com o cliente;

Capacidade para realizar pesquisas de mercado, identificando tendências, oportunidades e comportamento do consumidor;

Experiência em prospecção ativa de clientes e desenvolvimento de carteira.



Qualificações:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Marketing, Nutrição, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com vendas em PDV; negociação comercial; prospecção.
  • Experiência com a atuação no segmento alimentar, farmacêutico com medicamentos, nutracêuticos.
  • Residir em Feira de Santana.
  • CNH B atualizada e disponibilidade para viagens e pernoite;

title: Angular Developer- Realocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are you going to do?

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot and microservices architecture ;
  • Participate in end-to-end implementation projects , from requirements analysis to deployment and support;
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and scalability in cloud-based environments;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical solutions and best practices;
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, testing, and monitoring tools;
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the modernization of the technology stack.


What are we looking for?

  • Strong expertise in Angular (Components, Services, RxJS, Observables, NgRx or equivalent state management tools).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3/Sass , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs and micro-frontend architectures is a plus.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma, Jest, Cypress).
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows (Git, Docker, etc.).
  • Fluent English (mandatory) — both spoken and written;
  • Available and interested in realocation to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Android Developer
description:
Intermediate Android (Kotlin) Developer

Contract : 3 months + extensions

Remote : Brazil - 40 hours/wk

Rate : USD $15-19/hr


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience with Android Development, including the latest version of Android SDK
  • Ability to write clean code in Kotlin
  • Working experience with Android Jetpack and Design Patterns (MVVM , MVP, MVI)
  • Familiarity with RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Familiarity with building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines on GitHub actions


Nice to Have:

  • Other mobile development experience, including iOS development using Swift, or cross-platform development with React Native or Flutter


Job Description:

  • Designing and Building Apps: This involves translating design concepts and user requirements into functional Android applications.
  • Writing Code: Using programming languages like Java and Kotlin to create the app's logic, features, and user interface.
  • Working with the Android SDK: Utilizing the Android Software Development Kit (SDK) to access device features like the camera, GPS, and sensors.
  • Creating User-Friendly Interfaces: Designing intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces that are consistent with Android design guidelines.
  • Implementing App Navigation: Developing clear and logical navigation flows within the app.
  • Optimizing for Different Screen Sizes: Ensuring the app looks and functions correctly on a variety of Android devices with different screen sizes and resolutions.
  • Testing App Functionality: Conducting thorough testing to identify and fix bugs, errors, and performance issues.
  • Debugging Code: Using debugging tools to identify and resolve issues in the app's code.

title: Gerente Executivo Financeiro | Remoto
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Gerente Executivo Financeiro para compor o time Financeiro do Gran e mudar vidas com a gente!


O Gran é um ecossistema que une educação e tecnologia , que acelera e customiza o aprendizado para diferentes necessidades e momentos e que já impactou mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Hoje temos 2 verticais principais: a de Cursos Preparatórios e a Gran Faculdade.


Atualmente, são mais de 820 mil alunos e alunas , presentes em mais de 1.500 municípios brasileiros . Temos como motivação possibilitar uma educação de alta qualidade que seja diversa e inclusiva, geográfica e economicamente. Nossa tecnologia de ponta é um catalisador que impulsiona para muitas possibilidades de futuro.


Somos grandes defensores da ideia de que a educação é um direito de todos e fazemos o máximo para tornar isso uma realidade Brasil afora. Sabemos que a educação é a chave para muitos futuros possíveis e temos as ferramentas que facilitam o acesso de milhares de brasileiros ao ensino, em vários níveis.


Essa vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalho Gran Mundo , sendo 100% remoto. Dessa forma, você não precisa comparecer ao escritório, apenas em casos eventuais que serão avisados com antecedência e custeados pelo próprio Gran.


Todas as nossas vagas são no modelo de trabalho CLT.


Se interessou? Vem ser GranLover !


Quer saber mais sobre a gente? Clique AQUI para retornar para a página de carreiras.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

title: Software Consultant - Personalization
description:
OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Position: Personalization Specialist

We are seeking a skilled Personalization Specialist to join our team in Porto. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization platform, ensuring effective and continuous campaign management.

Responsibilities:

• Implement and maintain the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization platform.

• Develop and manage Personalization sitemaps using JavaScript, following the platform’s library and standards.

• Create and customize campaign templates, adapting global models or developing solutions from scratch.

• Collaborate with marketing and development teams to integrate the platform with other systems, ensuring campaign effectiveness and continuity.

• Monitor campaign performance and propose improvements to optimize results.

Requirements:

• Proven experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (Interaction Studio/Evergage).

• Skilled in developing Personalization sitemaps using JavaScript.

• Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

• Experience creating and customizing campaign templates.

• Strong teamwork skills with a results-oriented mindset.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement.

• Certifications in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization.

• Developer certification in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement.

Languages:

• English is not mandatory but considered a plus.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Resolver problemas e contribuir com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhece-las, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação
  • Experiência com APIs
  • Raciocínio logico


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:


  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis e focadas na cliente.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc
  • Entende como CI/CD funciona.
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo.
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento mobile


Informações adicionais

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)

  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Position: Personalization Specialist

We are seeking a skilled Personalization Specialist to join our team in Porto. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization platform, ensuring effective and continuous campaign management.

Responsibilities:

• Implement and maintain the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization platform.

• Develop and manage Personalization sitemaps using JavaScript, following the platform’s library and standards.

• Create and customize campaign templates, adapting global models or developing solutions from scratch.

• Collaborate with marketing and development teams to integrate the platform with other systems, ensuring campaign effectiveness and continuity.

• Monitor campaign performance and propose improvements to optimize results.

Requirements:

• Proven experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (Interaction Studio/Evergage).

• Skilled in developing Personalization sitemaps using JavaScript.

• Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

• Experience creating and customizing campaign templates.

• Strong teamwork skills with a results-oriented mindset.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement.

• Certifications in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization.

• Developer certification in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement.

Languages:

• English is not mandatory but considered a plus.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend de GenAI Pleno (BR)
description:
Você na Deloitte!



Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na organização com o portfólio de serviços profissionais mais diversificado do mundo, atuando como Desenvolvedor(a) Backend de GenAI . Na sua rotina, você irá:



  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de inferência para LLMs, incluindo pré e pós-processamento, garantindo boas práticas de Guard Rails;
  • Implementar orquestração de multi-agentes usando LangChain/LangGraph;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir integrações seguras via MCP para conectar aplicações internas, provedores de LLM e serviços de dados, garantindo conformidade e proteção de informações;
  • Desenvolvimento de buscas e otimizações de sistemas RAG em Bancos Vetoriais (ChromaDB, MilvusDB, AI Search, Pinecone);
  • Criar e instanciar containers utilizando Docker/Kubernetes e configurar o orquestrador para garantir alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade;
  • Projetar, construir, utilizar e otimizar bancos de dados PostgreSQL, garantindo modelagem eficiente, alta performance e integridade dos dados;
  • Conhecimento em gerenciamento de prompts e versionamento (Langfuse, LangSmith);
  • Conhecimento em geração de métricas de avaliação de LLM (Langfuse, deepEval);
  • Garantir práticas de CI/CD, testes automatizados e observabilidade;
  • Conhecimento de versionamento de código mantendo boas práticas (Git);
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (dados, produto, UX);
  • Contribuir para deploy e monitoramento em ambientes cloud.



Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.



Requisitos



O que precisa para você se candidatar a vaga?



  • Experiência avançada em Python e desenvolvimento backend, incluindo boas práticas e padrões de projetos, testes automatizados e otimização de código. (FastAPI, Flask, Django);
  • Conhecimento profundo em frameworks para IA generativa, especialmente LangChain e LangGraph, e familiaridade com conceitos de Orquestração de Multi-Agentes;
  • Sólida base em arquitetura de containers, com habilidade para criar imagens eficientes e configurar orquestradores para ambientes escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes;
  • Proficiência em bancos de dados relacionais, com foco em modelagem, tuning de performance e integridade em PostgreSQL;
  • Experiência com construção de ferramentas utilizando MCP (Model Context Protocol) e sistemas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) ;
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), envolvendo deploy, monitoramento e otimização de recursos. *Preferencial Azure;
  • Experiência na implementação de práticas de CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps (Azure Pipeline), incluindo configuração de pipelines, automação de testes e monitoramento para garantir qualidade e entrega contínua;
  • Experiencia com versionamento de código, utilizando melhores práticas de desenvolvimento com uso de comandos Git.



Diferenciais



  • Participação em soluções de IA ou sistemas críticos com múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Conhecimento em segurança para aplicações GenAI;
  • Certificações em cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP);
  • Certificações em IA e GenAI (Azure AI Engineer Associate ou equivalentes).

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Sr Java Developer
description:
Senior Java Developer – Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Developer to join our team and lead the modernization of our existing applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java development, hands-on experience with modern frameworks, and the ability to guide the migration of legacy systems to contemporary architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the migration of legacy applications (currently built on Struts 2.0 ) to modern frameworks and architectures.
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable applications using Java , Spring Framework , and Microservices .
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, propose solutions, and deliver high-quality software.
  • Participate in the full SDLC including analysis, design, coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Ensure code quality through best practices such as code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to design patterns.
  • Support and troubleshoot production issues, ensuring application stability and performance.

  • Leverage Python skills for automation, data processing, or backend scripting tasks (bonus).
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to improving overall team capability and processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6–10+ years of experience in Java/J2EE development .
  • Strong hands-on experience in Spring Boot , Spring MVC , Microservices , REST APIs, and related technologies.
  • Experience with Struts 2.0 or legacy frameworks and proven ability to migrate systems to modern architectures.
  • Good understanding of software design principles, OOP, design patterns , and best coding practices.
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps concepts.
  • Working knowledge of React or Angular (good to have).
  • Basic to intermediate experience with Python (bonus).

title: Head of School
description:
This role will be located in a school in Brazil; it is not remote


As International Schools Partnership increases its presence across Brazil, we are seeking Principals, Aspiring Principals, and Senior Leaders with strong K-12 experience and a track record of driving whole-school improvement. This is an opportunity for leaders who are passionate about Academic Excellence and who bring an operational and commercially minded approach to running high-quality schools.

Join a global network committed to empowering school leaders, encouraging innovation, and positively shaping learning communities throughout Brazil.

About International Schools Partnership

International Schools Partnership is a leading and growing group of 114 private international schools operating in 25 countries and educating over 92,500 students worldwide.

Our role is to support and enable our schools to become the schools of choice in their local communities and the global education sector. We strive to grow schools renowned for setting new standards of excellence in education, cultivating future-ready students and enriching the communities they serve.

Why choose International Schools Partnership to be your career of choice?

  • Global Outlook: Lead in an environment that promotes cultural awareness and international collaboration.
  • Commitment to Excellence: Join a group dedicated to delivering high-quality teaching and learning.
  • Modern Learning Environments: Work in innovative and well-resourced facilities designed for progressive education.
  • Leadership Growth: Benefit from continuous professional development and global leadership pathways.


Purpose of Role

The Principal leads with vision and integrity, fostering a safe, inclusive, and supportive school culture where learning thrives. By working collaboratively with their team, parents, and the wider International Schools Partnership network, they position the school as a “School of Choice” that delivers exceptional learning experiences and outcomes, translating into increased enrolment growth and higher student retention. Their responsibilities span safeguarding, driving teaching quality through evidence-based improvement, strategic planning, community engagement, and commercial performance. Parents/carers and students recognise and endorse the school for academic excellence, and teachers’ professional learning and development thrives under their stewardship of the school. The Principal reports to the Regional Managing Director (RMD).

Key Responsibilities

All sections are weighted equally at 25% from a performance perspective.

  • People Development and Wellbeing
  • Student Learning Outcomes
  • Grow Community and Deliver Exceptional Customer Service and Experience
  • Commercial Success


Key Skills

Strategic planning

Educational leadership

Safeguarding and Child Protection management

Inclusive leadership

Emotional intelligence

Building community

Stakeholder engagement

Team development

Performance management

Engaging communication

Data-driven decision-making

Marketing insights

Financial acumen

Change management

Collaborative mindset

Commitment to Safeguarding Principles

International Schools Partnership is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.

Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging

International Schools Partnership is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of International Schools Partnership through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho
description:
Tarefas.

  • Realizar atendimentos ambulatoriais (curativos, aferições, administração de medicamentos) e apoiar o Médico do Trabalho nas rotinas do ambulatório;
  • Controlar diariamente medicamentos, materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalares, incluindo verificação das bolsas de primeiros socorros;
  • Agendar e acompanhar exames ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos, demissionais, retorno ao trabalho e mudança de função);
  • Registrar e controlar atestados, afastamentos e situações de saúde dos colaboradores;
  • Auxiliar na investigação de acidentes, abertura de CAT e acompanhamento dos casos;
  • Participar da integração de novos colaboradores e apoiar campanhas de saúde, SIPAT e demais ações preventivas;
  • Apoiar o cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NR-7, NR-32, NR-1), realizar visitas domiciliares ou hospitalares quando necessário, e executar demais atividades inerentes à função atendendo aos padrões de qualidade, saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e eficiência energética estabelecidos pela companhia.


Perfil.

  • Curso completo em Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho;
  • Registro no Órgão Profissional (COREN);
  • Pacote Office básico;
  • Conhecimento no sistema Sênior será um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no 2º turno


Benefícios.

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Prêmio Assiduidade - Vale-alimentação Sodexo;
  • PPR;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Transporte;
  • Alimentação na empresa subsidiada com refeitório próprio.

title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.


Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil

A International Schools Partnership está comprometida com a segurança e o bem-estar de crianças e jovens. Todos os profissionais devem cumprir processos rigorosos de verificação de antecedentes referentes aos últimos 10 anos de experiência.


Compromisso com Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

A International Schools Partnership promove uma cultura inclusiva e acolhedora, contratando e desenvolvendo talentos independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, deficiência, neurodivergência ou origem socioeconômica. Encorajamos candidaturas de profissionais que compartilham nossos valores e desejam contribuir para o sucesso da organização.

title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.


Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil

A International Schools Partnership está comprometida com a segurança e o bem-estar de crianças e jovens. Todos os profissionais devem cumprir processos rigorosos de verificação de antecedentes referentes aos últimos 10 anos de experiência.


Compromisso com Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

A International Schools Partnership promove uma cultura inclusiva e acolhedora, contratando e desenvolvendo talentos independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, deficiência, neurodivergência ou origem socioeconômica. Encorajamos candidaturas de profissionais que compartilham nossos valores e desejam contribuir para o sucesso da organização.

title: AI Agent Developer Jr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Analista de Automação de IA Jr

Contratação CLT


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mão na massa e experiência prática comprovada em ferramentas de automação e integração para atuar na criação de agentes inteligentes e fluxos com IA generativa. Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, APIs REST e está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.

Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Mapear processos repetitivos e oportunidades de automação utilizando IA e integrações inteligentes.
  • Criar, configurar e manter agentes operacionais integrados a ferramentas como Microsoft Teams, Jira, Supabase e WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver automações robustas e reutilizáveis com ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Conectar APIs e Webhooks para promover fluxos dinâmicos entre sistemas.
  • Aplicar IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para automatizar decisões, gerar conteúdo e criar experiências personalizadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das automações e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender dores reais e traduzir em soluções operacionais com IA.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados nas integrações.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia em automações no ar com pelo menos uma das ferramentas: N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com integrações via APIs REST e Webhooks.
  • Noções de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (ex: Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento introdutório ou prático em IA generativa e uso de modelos como ChatGPT.
  • Organização, curiosidade, boa comunicação e autonomia para aprender fazendo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e entregar soluções com qualidade, mesmo em contextos de baixa complexidade.


Diferenciais

  • Já ter desenvolvido bots ou agentes internos, mesmo em projetos pessoais ou freelas.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Teams Bot Framework ou WhatsApp Business API.
  • Noções de Machine Learning, fluxos com NLP ou experiências com LLMs.
  • Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou hackathons.
  • Conhecimento em documentação técnica e lógica de versionamento (ex: ReadMe, Notion, Git).

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
  • Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
  • Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
  • Intermediate computer software skills required.
  • Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: Software Engineer (Murex)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Murex Developer to join our team, supporting strategic initiatives within the financial sector. The role begins as fully remote , with the expectation of relocation to Portugal after an agreed transition period. You will work closely with multicultural teams, contributing to the enhancement and stability of the Murex MX.3 platform.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, customize, and maintain components and configurations within Murex MX.3 , across modules such as Trading, Risk, Collateral, and Back Office.
  • Build and enhance workflows, simulation views, formulas, and MxML Exchange interfaces.
  • Design and maintain integrations with internal and external systems (REST, SOAP, MQ, APIs, ETL, etc.).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.
  • Maintain compliance with technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.


Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Murex MX.3 (configuration, development, or integration).
  • Solid knowledge of Datamart, MxML Exchange, Workflows, Simulation Views , and other core Murex components.
  • Strong programming skills: Java, SQL, Shell Script , and ideally Python.
  • Experience with system integrations, middleware, or messaging platforms.
  • Good understanding of financial instruments, especially derivatives (FX, IRD, Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities).
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Willingness and eligibility to relocate to Portugal after the initial remote period.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with major banks or large international financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum .
  • Murex certifications or experience with MX.2 → MX.3 migrations.

Desired Profile

  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote and multicultural environments.
  • Proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure.
  • Motivated to engage in a long-term role involving relocation.

What We Offer

  • Remote work during the initial phase.
  • Support and guidance for future relocation to Portugal .
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact financial systems.
  • Multicultural work environment and professional growth opportunities.
