title: Desenvolvedor full stack pleno
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver e evoluir o aplicativo de frente de loja (PDV) e os serviços de backend associados, garantindo alta disponibilidade, performance e uma ótima experiência do usuário. Atuar na integração e homologação de terminais POS com adquirentes de pagamentos eletrônicos do mercado brasileiro e participar do ciclo de publicação de apps.


Sobre a oportunidade

Você fará parte do time de PDV, trabalhando próximo ao Tech Lead, PO, QA e Suporte N2. Esperamos autonomia para entregar funcionalidades ponta a ponta, boa comunicação e foco em qualidade, com responsabilidade sobre o que desenvolve.


Responsabilidades

  • Implementar funcionalidades end-to-end: mobile (React Native) e backend (Node.js/TypeScript)
  • Integrar e homologar SDKs/APIs de adquirentes e POS Android (testes de crédito/débito, parcelado, estorno, contactless, logs e evidências)
  • Participar do processo de publicação de apps (Google Play/App Store) ou distribuição corporativa/MDM: versionamento, assinatura e tracks
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST, integrações com sistemas legados e serviços terceiros
  • Escrever testes, realizar code reviews e colaborar na melhoria contínua da qualidade e performance
  • Monitorar e atuar no troubleshooting de incidentes em produção, com suporte do time
  • Documentar fluxos técnicos, integrações e decisões relevantes
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis, estimativas e planejamento
  • Apoiar pilotos/homologações em campo quando necessário (eventuais deslocamentos)


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software (nível Pleno), incluindo:
  • React Native (foco Android)
  • Node.js e TypeScript (APIs REST)
  • Integração com SDKs/APIs e boas práticas para fluxos de pagamento (idempotência, tratamento de erros e timeouts)
  • Banco de dados relacional (PostgreSQL) e escrita de queries performáticas,
  • Git, pipelines básicos de CI/CD e organização de ambientes (dev/homolog/produção)
  • Noções de Monitoramento e logs (ex.: Sentry, CloudWatch, Grafana/Kibana) voltados à rastreabilidade de transações
  • Noções de segurança e LGPD aplicadas a apps e APIs (armazenamento seguro, criptografia, tokens)
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e SDKs

title: UX/UI DESIGN
description:
Olá, somos a ETUS

Somos uma MadTech, atuamos na interseção entre marketing, mídia e tecnologia, com soluções que conectam marcas e pessoas de forma estratégica, automatizada e orientada por dados.

ETUS significa Eu Tenho Um Sonho. Nascemos com o propósito de transformar vidas por meio do empreendedorismo, da inclusão e da inovação. Em poucos anos, construímos um ecossistema completo de empresas focadas em performance, mídia programática, inteligência de dados, tecnologia SaaS e otimização de conversão (CRO).

Hoje, impactamos milhões de pessoas, com uma equipe apaixonada por desafios, crescimento e propósito. Aqui, acreditamos que sonhar é o primeiro passo para transformar realidades.

Se você procura um ambiente dinâmico, e já se imaginou trabalhando com um bando de gente incrível, que ama o impossível e está sempre disposta a mudar o jogo, seu lugar é aqui.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa UX/UI Design Pleno para atuar com foco em CRO (Otimização de Conversão), desenvolvendo interfaces digitais estratégicas para sites, landing pages e fluxos de conversão. Essa pessoa atuará em parceria direta com o time de CRO, transformando diagnósticos, pesquisas e wireframes em interfaces visuais consistentes, funcionais e orientadas a resultados.

A posição é indicada para quem entende que design vai além da estética e atua como ferramenta de clareza, impacto visual e performance de negócio.


Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

● Criar layouts de alta fidelidade para sites, landing pages e fluxos digitais, com foco em conversão.

● Transformar wireframes de baixa fidelidade em interfaces visuais bem resolvidas, consistentes e alinhadas ao posicionamento das marcas.

● Trabalhar em parceria direta com Estrategistas de CRO, recebendo diagnósticos, pesquisas, copy e direcionamentos que servirão como base para a criação das interfaces.

● Adaptar layouts para desktop e mobile, garantindo hierarquia visual, responsividade e boa experiência do usuário.

● Criar, manter e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e estruturas de design system quando necessário.

● Atuar simultaneamente em múltiplos projetos e clientes de diferentes segmentos, como bancos, fintechs, SaaS, e-commerce e geração de leads.


Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios:

● Experiência sólida com UI Design, especialmente para sites e landing pages.

● Domínio avançado de Figma, incluindo componentes, Auto Layout e protótipos navegáveis.

● Portfólio online com projetos de UI Design (item indispensável no processo seletivo).

● Boa base em UX/UI Design, com foco em clareza, usabilidade e simplificação de problemas complexos.

● Experiência ou familiaridade com design systems e organização de componentes.

● Capacidade de executar com qualidade a partir de orientações claras, mantendo criatividade, organização e alinhamento com o time.

● Autonomia, senso de responsabilidade, comprometimento com prazos e boa gestão de demandas.

● Boa comunicação e abertura para dar e receber feedbacks.


Diferenciais desejáveis:

● Experiência prévia com projetos de CRO, testes A/B ou otimização de conversão.

● Conhecimento em Photoshop e Illustrator.

● Uso de ferramentas de IA no processo de criação ou edição de imagens.

● Experiência na criação de sites e landing pages do zero no Figma.

● Interesse genuíno por tendências de design e evolução constante do repertório visual.


O que faz a diferença por aqui: Nosso clube PLUS

️ iFood Benefícios – Crédito mensal para você escolher onde e o que quiser comer, com liberdade e praticidade.

Wellhub | Gympass – Acesso a academias, personal trainers, estúdios e apps de bem-estar para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico AMIL ONE – Sem mensalidade para você e seus filhos (até 18 anos), e sem coparticipação. Cuidado de ponta, sem custo extra.

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida – Tempo de qualidade com quem mais importa.

Vale Celebration – Um mimo em momentos importantes como casamento, nascimento de filhos e aniversário.

️ ♂️ AVUS, Starbem e DASA – Parceiras de saúde e bem-estar que completam o nosso cuidado integral com você.

️ Curso de idiomas (inglês ou espanhol) – Para expandir horizontes e crescer junto com a gente.

No dress code – Aqui você é livre para se vestir do seu jeito. Seja você.

Horário flexível – Para facilitar sua rotina.

Refeição e lanches na sede – Energia garantida com comida boa e sempre por perto.

Balas e doces sempre à disposição – Porque um docinho salva o dia!

title: Analista de Compliance Pleno
description:
Sobre a Velaro Network

A Velaro Network é uma prestadora de serviços de ativos virtuais comprometida com os mais altos padrões de compliance e segurança, preparando-se para atuar em plena conformidade com o marco regulatório brasileiro de ativos virtuais.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Compliance, preferencialmente em instituições financeiras ou fintechs
  • Conhecimento sólido em prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro (AML) e combate ao financiamento do terrorismo (CFT)
  • Familiaridade com processos de KYC e análise de risco
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Mentalidade proativa e senso de responsabilidade

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência no mercado de criptomoedas ou ativos virtuais
  • Experiência com compliance regulatório em instituições financeiras
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de compliance (Chainalysis, sistemas de monitoramento transacional)
  • Certificações em compliance (CAMS, CGRC ou similares)

O que mais valorizamos

Soft Skills:

  • Vontade de aprender : buscamos pessoas curiosas, que queiram se desenvolver e crescer junto com a empresa em um mercado em rápida evolução
  • Adaptabilidade : capacidade de atuar em ambiente dinâmico e de regulamentação emergente
  • Trabalho em equipe : colaboração genuína e disposição para compartilhar conhecimento
  • Ética e integridade : compromisso inabalável com condutas éticas e conformidade regulatória
  • Organização : habilidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas e prioridades
  • Pensamento crítico : capacidade de questionar, propor melhorias e contribuir para o aperfeiçoamento contínuo dos processos

O que oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de participar ativamente da construção de uma VASP regulada no Brasil
  • Espaço para crescimento e desenvolvimento de novas competências
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e transparente
  • Desenvolvimento profissional em um mercado inovador e em crescimento
  • Trabalho remoto com flexibilidade

title: Junior Developer (Devvit Platform)
description:
We're looking for a Junior Developer 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote (100%)

Employment Type: CLT

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Junior Developer to lead the creation of engaging, high-performance in-app community experiences aligned with major UK cultural moments. This role blends full-stack development with a deep understanding of online communities, culture, and data-driven iteration. You will own the full lifecycle of features—from concept to deployment—while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners to drive meaningful user engagement during peak activity periods.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the conceptualisation, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments.
  • Drive community engagement during peak user periods by launching client-facing, technically robust features built on the Devvit Developer Platform.
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into scalable, high-performance web applications within a large social platform ecosystem.
  • Own the full development lifecycle, from ideation and prototyping through deployment and iteration.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the culture and technical needs of focus communities to inform content, feature sets, and engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to convert strategic growth goals and community feedback into clear technical requirements and deliverables.
  • Conduct data analysis and research on application performance and usage metrics to guide feature prioritisation and optimisation.

Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Demonstrable expertise with modern client-side frameworks, particularly React .
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js , preferably with frameworks such as Express or Koa .
  • Strong understanding of API integration, data modelling, and client/server architecture patterns.
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage.
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is highly desirable.

General Requirements

  • Fluent in English , with a deep understanding of UK culture and language nuances.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple development and community launch cycles simultaneously.
  • Experience designing and executing community activations and interactive platform experiences.
  • Strong familiarity with large-scale online discussion platforms and user expectations.
  • Ability to quickly understand and adapt to diverse topics and content verticals.
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to community growth initiatives.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on high-impact community experiences tied to major cultural moments.
  • Autonomy to own features end-to-end in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Flexible contract hours within a globally distributed team.

If you are passionate about building community-driven products and enjoy combining cultural insight with technical excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

  • JavaScript / TypeScript (Node.js)

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Ascendion

Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.


Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life


We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for the world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience.


Experience a community of change-makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Scientist

Contract Type: Contract in Brazil

Office model - Remote


We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist focused on evaluating LLM-based products. The role is all about making sure AI outputs are high-quality, accurate, safe, and useful, using a mix of human evaluation and LLM-based evaluation approaches (LLM-as-a-Judge and LLM-as-a-Jury). You’ll work closely with SMEs, product, and engineering teams to build and scale evaluation frameworks that help improve AI products.


What You’ll Do:


  • Review and evaluate LLM outputs for quality, accuracy, safety, and relevance.
  • Work with SMEs on manual and human-in-the-loop evaluations.
  • Use LLMs to evaluate other LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge / LLM-as-a-Jury)
  • Define simple evaluation criteria and scoring guidelines.
  • Analyze results and share clear feedback with product and engineering teams.
  • Help improve evaluation processes and best practices over time.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 6-7 years of experience in Data Science, ML, or AI roles.
  • Strong experience with LLMs and Generative AI.
  • AWS: Core AWS - Lambda, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, etc.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLM outputs (manual or automated).
  • Solid Python skills for analysis and automation.
  • Experience with LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, or similar.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.


Nice to Haves:


  • Experience with AI evaluation metrics or quality frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or AI monitoring.
  • Interest in AI safety, reliability, and responsible AI processes.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Profitable , +100M ARRR, + 1M MAUs, +8M clients, fintech accelerated in Silicon Valley needs you!

Help us improve the lives of 34 million workers in financial distress

We are a profitable, series A startup growing 10% MoM with more than $60M of annualized revenue helping workers without access to credit. We believe we can improve the lives of Brazilian workers offering salary advances.

We are invested by Monashees, ONEVC, and YCombinator. We believe a top-performing team is the most vital factor to a startup’s success.

Position: Chief of Staff

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to be the CEO’s strategic partner—helping drive priorities, bring clarity and alignment across teams, and maximize effectiveness.

This is a career accelerator role: you’ll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, with direct exposure to company decision-making, fundraising, growth, and operations. You’ll be embedded in the hardest challenges of scaling a high-growth fintech in one of the world’s most dynamic markets.

Your work will focus on three areas:

1. Strategic Execution & Decision Support

  • Partner with the CEO to prioritize and drive the most critical company-wide initiatives.
  • Dig into strategic questions—pricing, incentives, product-market fit, operational efficiency.
  • Generate high-leverage insights from data, market research, and direct user feedback.
  • Prepare decision frameworks, board materials, and briefing docs to enable fast, high-quality decisions.

2. Cross-Functional Alignment & Special Projects

  • Act as a connector across Product, Marketing, Finance, Credit and Operations—ensuring priorities are clear and execution sharp.
  • Identify and remove roadblocks, whether data gaps, misalignment, or process bottlenecks.
  • Drive high-impact special projects—ranging from new product launches to operational improvements.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to executives, bringing an enterprise-wide perspective.

3. CEO Leverage & Investor Communications

  • Ensure the CEO’s time and focus are on the highest-leverage activities by filtering noise and structuring decisions.
  • Craft crisp, compelling communications—internal memos, board decks, investor updates, and team announcements.
  • Act as a sounding board: challenge assumptions, pressure-test ideas, and refine strategy.



Who You Are:

This role is for a sharp, driven, adaptable operator who thrives in ambiguity and wants a front-row seat to building a category-defining fintech.

You are:

  • A Strategic Thinker Who Executes: You break down complex problems into clear insights and actions. You anticipate second-order effects and make things happen.
  • A Strong Communicator & Influencer: You can synthesize complexity into clarity, influence across levels, and drive alignment.
  • Comfortable in Ambiguity: You thrive in messy, undefined challenges and move quickly to bring order.
  • Curious to learn & eager to Grow: You want exposure to strategy, fundraising, and scaling operations—and see this role as a launchpad for future leadership.
Qualifications

We don’t expect a single “right” background, but you likely have:

  • 2–4 years of experience in consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, or high-growth startups.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; comfort with SQL, Excel, Python and business metrics a plus.
  • Proven track record of cross-functional project execution.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to take ownership and deliver results in unstructured environments.
Why This Role?
  • Unparalleled Exposure: Work side-by-side with a CEO who has scaled fintech to millions of users.
  • AI-native Company : We’re turning all departments into execution driven functions powered by LLMs and automation.
  • High-Impact Work: Tackle the most pressing strategic challenges at Brazil’s fastest-growing salary advance platform.
  • Career Acceleration: A launchpad into future leadership roles in fintech, strategy, or entrepreneurship.
  • Mission That Matters: Directly impact the financial lives of millions of Brazilian workers.
About us:
  • Fully remote - we meet 4 times a year in São Paulo (flight & accommodations on us)
  • We pay above market with top edge stock options package
  • Twice weekly AI classes
  • CLT / PJ

title: ANALISTA RELAÇÕES COM INVESTIDORES SR.
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


Qual será sua missão?


  • Tem como responsabilidades o atendimento às exigências dos órgãos regulamentadores do Mercado de Capitais no Brasil, preparação de relatórios trimestrais com o resultado da Companhia, manutenção e atualização do site de Relações com Investidores da Companhia, atendimento aos analistas buy side e sell side, bem como atendimento aos investidores e potenciais investidores da Companhia;
  • É responsável pela preparação dos materiais que a Companhia divulga para o Mercado Financeiro e pela conferência das informações que são divulgadas para a imprensa;
  • Acompanhar, monitorar e entender os números e indicadores das empresas concorrentes e a preparação de apresentações institucionais para o público interno e externo, além de apresentações de resultados para o mercado financeiro e para o Conselho de Administração e Conselho Fiscal da Companhia;
  • Preparação e envio de informações para advogados, bancos e órgãos regulamentadores em caso de ofertas públicas de ações ou dívida e controle e monitoramento da base acionária da Companhia;
  • Conhecer as regras de mercado de capitais, melhores práticas de governança, além de conhecimentos financeiros e do setor de atuação da Companhia.


Responsabilidades:


  • Preparar e enviar informações para os órgãos reguladores do Mercado de Capitais Brasileiro: Inclui a preparação de Formulário de Referência, preparação e envio de informações financeiras, comunicados ao mercado e fatos relevantes e preparação de Formulário Cadastral;
  • Analisar dos indicadores operacionais e financeiros da Companhia para preparação de release de resultados, além de mensagem da administração;
  • Preparar apresentação de resultados para os calls de resultados conduzidos pelo Presidente e CFO; Preparação de apresentação para aprovação dos resultados nos Conselhos de Administração e Fiscal;
  • Preparação de apresentações institucionais para reuniões com analistas sell side e buy side e investidores;
  • Realizar apresentação institucional da companhia para analistas de bancos, corretoras e assets, bem como investidores e potenciais investidores;
  • Conduzir reuniões e responder as dúvidas dos investidores e analistas, bem como fornecer as informações financeiras e a participação em conferências e feita junto com os superiores;
  • Assegurar que todas as informações divulgadas ao mercado estão no site e estão atualizadas;
  • Acompanhar os resultados e conhecer as estratégias e principais números dos concorrentes para poder conversar com analistas de mercado e preparar relatórios internos para diretoria e
  • Responsável pela preparação de comunicados ao mercado (financeiros, novos negócios ou comunicados de marketing), fatos relevantes e conferência dos números e informações que as diversas áreas da Companhia passam para o mercado em geral;
  • Preparação dos documentos que precisam ser enviados aos bancos, advogados e órgãos regulamentadores;
  • Acompanhamento e monitoramento da base acionária.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% presencial.

Requisito: Inglês Avançado.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Full-Stack Developer / UI Designer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a hybrid Developer/Designer who can build modern, scalable web

experiences using TypeScript, Next.js, Node and related technologies, while also producing

polished, on-brand UI/UX in Figma. This role blends engineering, design, and AI-assised

development. The ideal candidate moves quickly, takes initiative, and delivers exceptional

quality with minimal oversight.


Responsibilities

Full-Stack Web Development

● Build and maintain headless websites and applications using Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and TypeScript.

● Implement responsive, performant, and accessible front-end interfaces aligned with design specs.

● Develop backend functionality, APIs, serverless functions, and integrations.

● Use AI-powered tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex/Copilot) to accelerate coding workflows and improve output quality.

Web Design / UI & UX

● Translate brand guidelines into consistent layouts, UI patterns, and interactions.

● Conduct UX improvements across flows, navigation, content structure, and responsiveness.

● Deliver clear handoff files, annotations, and design documentation to ensure smooth implementation.

● Contribute to concept development, ideation, and early-stage visual direction.


Required qualifications

● 4+ years of experience building headless websites or modern web apps, preferably with Next.js.

● Hands-on experience with headless CMSs (Contentful, Prismic, Sanity, etc.)

● Strong proficiency with React, Tailwind, Node.js, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.

● Demonstrated UI/UX ability with a portfolio of Figma designs.

● Experience creating or managing reusable design systems.

● Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex/Copilot).

● Ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive projects with minimal supervision.

● Strong understanding of accessibility, responsive design, and performance optimization.

● Excellent communication skills and comfort with asynchronous collaboration.

● Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with Pacific Time (8 AM–12 PM PT).

● Experience with Webflow.

● Experience with Prismic CMS.

● Experience maintaining design systems in Figma.

About Us

We’re a Boston-based real estate company seeking a detail-oriented accounting professional fluent in English to support our CFO with bookkeeping, financial reporting, and analysis. This remote role is based in Brazil and requires daily communication in English via Zoom and chat.

  • Create and manage QuickBooks invoices, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Categorize receipts and expenses; prepare monthly financial reports
  • Maintain spreadsheets for rental and mortgage tracking
  • Assist with budgets, financial models, and investor proposals
  • Provide accurate financial data and support the CFO on accounting projects
  • Manage compliance documentation by reviewing transaction files for accuracy and submitting documents for approval


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (or other accounting software and willingness to learn)
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets (or Excel and willingness to learn Google Sheets)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); all work and meetings are in English
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable managing multiple priorities

  • Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM Eastern (Boston time zone)


Compensation

  • Remote from Brazil

Please submit your application through LinkedIn with your resume in English .

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Profitable , +100M ARRR, + 1M MAUs, +8M clients, fintech accelerated in Silicon Valley needs you!

Help us improve the lives of 34 million workers in financial distress

We are a profitable, series A startup growing 10% MoM with more than $60M of annualized revenue helping workers without access to credit. We believe we can improve the lives of Brazilian workers offering salary advances.

We are invested by Monashees, ONEVC, and YCombinator. We believe a top-performing team is the most vital factor to a startup’s success.

Position: Chief of Staff

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to be the CEO’s strategic partner—helping drive priorities, bring clarity and alignment across teams, and maximize effectiveness.

This is a career accelerator role: you’ll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, with direct exposure to company decision-making, fundraising, growth, and operations. You’ll be embedded in the hardest challenges of scaling a high-growth fintech in one of the world’s most dynamic markets.

Your work will focus on three areas:

1. Strategic Execution & Decision Support

  • Partner with the CEO to prioritize and drive the most critical company-wide initiatives.
  • Dig into strategic questions—pricing, incentives, product-market fit, operational efficiency.
  • Generate high-leverage insights from data, market research, and direct user feedback.
  • Prepare decision frameworks, board materials, and briefing docs to enable fast, high-quality decisions.

2. Cross-Functional Alignment & Special Projects

  • Act as a connector across Product, Marketing, Finance, Credit and Operations—ensuring priorities are clear and execution sharp.
  • Identify and remove roadblocks, whether data gaps, misalignment, or process bottlenecks.
  • Drive high-impact special projects—ranging from new product launches to operational improvements.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to executives, bringing an enterprise-wide perspective.

3. CEO Leverage & Investor Communications

  • Ensure the CEO’s time and focus are on the highest-leverage activities by filtering noise and structuring decisions.
  • Craft crisp, compelling communications—internal memos, board decks, investor updates, and team announcements.
  • Act as a sounding board: challenge assumptions, pressure-test ideas, and refine strategy.



Who You Are:

This role is for a sharp, driven, adaptable operator who thrives in ambiguity and wants a front-row seat to building a category-defining fintech.

You are:

  • A Strategic Thinker Who Executes: You break down complex problems into clear insights and actions. You anticipate second-order effects and make things happen.
  • A Strong Communicator & Influencer: You can synthesize complexity into clarity, influence across levels, and drive alignment.
  • Comfortable in Ambiguity: You thrive in messy, undefined challenges and move quickly to bring order.
  • Curious to learn & eager to Grow: You want exposure to strategy, fundraising, and scaling operations—and see this role as a launchpad for future leadership.
Qualifications

We don’t expect a single “right” background, but you likely have:

  • 2–4 years of experience in consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, or high-growth startups.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; comfort with SQL, Excel, Python and business metrics a plus.
  • Proven track record of cross-functional project execution.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to take ownership and deliver results in unstructured environments.
Why This Role?
  • Unparalleled Exposure: Work side-by-side with a CEO who has scaled fintech to millions of users.
  • AI-native Company : We’re turning all departments into execution driven functions powered by LLMs and automation.
  • High-Impact Work: Tackle the most pressing strategic challenges at Brazil’s fastest-growing salary advance platform.
  • Career Acceleration: A launchpad into future leadership roles in fintech, strategy, or entrepreneurship.
  • Mission That Matters: Directly impact the financial lives of millions of Brazilian workers.
About us:
  • Fully remote - we meet 4 times a year in São Paulo (flight & accommodations on us)
  • We pay above market with top edge stock options package
  • Twice weekly AI classes
  • CLT / PJ
Process:
  • CV Screening, 2 interviews, 2 cases
  • Applicants reviewed on rolling basis

title: Content Labeler / Moderator (Portuguese)
description:
Project Background(Toxic Words Labeling)

This project focuses on cleaning and annotating in-game voice content, with an emphasis on identifying sensitive language such as violent expressions and profanity. The resulting training data will help better distinguish ambiguous content and support overall content safety and user experience improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Download the audio to your local computer through the audio link for playback.
  • Determine whether the audio contains toxic words. If so, mark \"Toxic\" in the \"Is toxic\" column of the table. If the audio does not contain toxic words, mark \"Normal\"
  • For words containing toxic, mark each time point of the toxic word in the \"Note\" column (if a word is repeated multiple times, the time point of each occurrence must be marked) and the toxic word, and its corresponding English translation
  • List the 20 English translations of the most frequently occurring dirty words (it is not necessary to collect 20, as many as possible)


Requirements

  • Native Portuguese based in Brazil, fluent in both spoken and written English (minimum B2 English level)
  • Available 30-40 hours per week with relatively fixed daily schedule
  • Up-to-date PC (Windows 10 or later) or Mac (Big Sur or later) with stable utility and internet connection
  • Degree and/or working experience in literature, translation, linguistics, teaching is a plus
  • Similar project experience in data collection, annotation, quality control, coordination is a plus


Training & Payment

  • Each participant will attend approximately 1 hour of training
  • Actual work will be paid based on completed cases.
  • Estimated time per case is about 1 minute, based on internal testing.


Additional Notes

  • The project is expected to run for approximately 3–4 weeks. Please ensure that you are able to remain available for the full project duration and meet the output targets as defined by the Project Manager.
  • Once you confirm participation in this project, early withdrawal during the project period is not permitted

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Ascendion

Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.


Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life


We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for the world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience.


Experience a community of change-makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Scientist

Contract Type: Contract in Brazil

Office model - Remote


We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist focused on evaluating LLM-based products. The role is all about making sure AI outputs are high-quality, accurate, safe, and useful, using a mix of human evaluation and LLM-based evaluation approaches (LLM-as-a-Judge and LLM-as-a-Jury). You’ll work closely with SMEs, product, and engineering teams to build and scale evaluation frameworks that help improve AI products.


What You’ll Do:


  • Review and evaluate LLM outputs for quality, accuracy, safety, and relevance.
  • Work with SMEs on manual and human-in-the-loop evaluations.
  • Use LLMs to evaluate other LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge / LLM-as-a-Jury)
  • Define simple evaluation criteria and scoring guidelines.
  • Analyze results and share clear feedback with product and engineering teams.
  • Help improve evaluation processes and best practices over time.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 6-7 years of experience in Data Science, ML, or AI roles.
  • Strong experience with LLMs and Generative AI.
  • AWS: Core AWS - Lambda, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, etc.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLM outputs (manual or automated).
  • Solid Python skills for analysis and automation.
  • Experience with LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, or similar.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.


Nice to Haves:


  • Experience with AI evaluation metrics or quality frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or AI monitoring.
  • Interest in AI safety, reliability, and responsible AI processes.

title: SAP ABAP IBP Developer
description:
Senior SAP ABAP Developer (IBP / Finance Focus)

Project: IBP Rollout

Contract Duration: Start date 5th of January - 3 months + possible extension

Location: Remote but must be based in Brazil

Start Date: 4th of January

Workload: 5 days/week

Language: English and Portuguese


Seeking an experienced Senior SAP ABAP Developer to support its global IBP (Integrated Business Planning) implementation across Europe, North and South America. The consultant will replace an outgoing developer and play a key role in building and maintaining interfaces, enhancements, and integrations within the SAP ECC environment.

  • Develop and maintain custom ABAP programs, function modules, BADIs, BAPIs, and iDOCs

  • Participate in code reviews and ensure compliance with SAP development standards


Required Skills & Experience


  • 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience (ECC environment)
  • Proven experience in IBP and Finance integration projects
  • Strong understanding of data interfaces and integration frameworks (iDOCs, BAPIs, RFCs, BADIs)
  • Familiarity with middleware systems (Workado or similar)
  • Experience supporting international, multi-region SAP environments
  • Excellent English communication and team collaboration skills


Nice to Have


  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA (awareness level acceptable) Not mandatory
  • Previous experience in manufacturing / industrial sectors

title: SAP ABAP IBP Developer
description:
Senior SAP ABAP Developer (IBP / Finance Focus)

Project: IBP Rollout

Contract Duration: Start date 5th of January - 3 months + possible extension

Location: Remote but must be based in Brazil

Start Date: 4th of January

Workload: 5 days/week

Language: English and Portuguese


Seeking an experienced Senior SAP ABAP Developer to support its global IBP (Integrated Business Planning) implementation across Europe, North and South America. The consultant will replace an outgoing developer and play a key role in building and maintaining interfaces, enhancements, and integrations within the SAP ECC environment.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop and maintain custom ABAP programs, function modules, BADIs, BAPIs, and iDOCs
  • Design and implement integrations between SAP ECC and middleware tools (e.g., Workado)
  • Build custom tables and data interfaces to support IBP and Finance streams
  • Collaborate with functional teams, integration leads, and other developers across regions
  • Support performance optimization, troubleshooting, and documentation of technical solutions
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure compliance with SAP development standards


Required Skills & Experience


  • 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience (ECC environment)
  • Proven experience in IBP and Finance integration projects
  • Strong understanding of data interfaces and integration frameworks (iDOCs, BAPIs, RFCs, BADIs)
  • Familiarity with middleware systems (Workado or similar)
  • Experience supporting international, multi-region SAP environments
  • Excellent English communication and team collaboration skills


Nice to Have


  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA (awareness level acceptable) Not mandatory
  • Previous experience in manufacturing / industrial sectors

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora FullStack .NET e Angular ou React - Pleno
description:
A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora FullStack .NET e Angular 2+ ou React - Pleno, para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver aplicações Front-End utilizando Angular 2+ ou React.
  • Manter e evoluir sistemas existentes , analisando e depurando códigos com ferramentas como IDEs e DevTools do navegador (F12).
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST com .NET Core e Entity Framework.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura de software , como DDD (Domain-Driven Design), injeção de dependência e testes unitários.
  • Trabalhar com mensageria , principalmente RabbitMQ, mas também com alternativas como SQS, SNS ou Kafka.
  • Projetar e manter sistemas distribuídos baseados em microserviços.
  • Monitorar e diagnosticar aplicações usando ferramentas de observabilidade (ex: DataDog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch).
  • Utilizar bancos de dados não relacionais , como MongoDB ou DynamoDB.
  • Participar de pipelines de CI/CD , garantindo entregas contínuas e seguras.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias de containerização e orquestração , como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Utilizar serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure, etc.) , incluindo funções serverless e mensageria.
  • Colaborar em projetos via Azure DevOps , utilizando boards, pipelines e repositórios.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiencia com FrontEnd, Angular 2+ ou React;
  • Proficiência para novos desenvolvimentos e para entendimento de códigos existentes, bem como debugar aplicações e frontend na IDE e pelo F12 no browser;
  • Experiencia em desenvolvimento de WebApi .Net Core
  • EntityFramework
  • Injeção de Dependencia
  • DDD
  • Testes unitários
  • Candidato ambicioso, com vontade de crescer na carreira e força de vontade pra trabalhar/fazer horas extras.
  • Experiencia com ferramentas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Sqs, Sns, Kafka), preferencialmente RabbitMQ
  • Experiencia com sistemas distribuídos, com microserviços que interagem entre si;
  • Experiencia com alguma ferramenta de observabilidade/logs, como DataDog, azuremonitor; CloudWatch
  • Banco de dados não relacional (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experiencia com ambiente de trabalho com estrutura de CI-CD
  • Experiencia com pelo menos 3 ferramentas de Cloud(Exemplo: Aws lambda, Azure functions, SQS, SNS, EC2)
  • Experiencia com docker e kubernetes;
  • Experiencia ou conhecimento do Azure DevOps

Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

title: Freelance Photographer
description:
We are seeking skilled and reliable freelance photographers to support an upcoming visual content initiative. This role involves capturing a small set of high-quality images following a general creative brief. Photographers may work with models or self-shoot, depending on preference and availability.

This is a great opportunity for photographers looking to take on flexible contract work, build their portfolio, or collaborate on a unique project.

About the Role

Photographers will be responsible for producing a series of clear, well-lit images that meet the project’s technical and creative guidelines. The work can be completed at your preferred location, using your own equipment. 

No specialized gear is required; modern smartphones or standard photography equipment are both acceptable as long as they meet basic quality expectations. 

Responsabilities

  • Capture a small set of photos following a simple creative brief
  • Ensure images are well-composed and meet general quality standards
  • Work independently and deliver files within the requested timeframe
  • Communicate promptly and professionally throughout the project
  • Provide all required files and any accompanying forms upon completion

Qualifications

  • Experience in photography (professional or amateur)
  • Ability to capture clear, high-quality images
  • Reliable communication and attention to detail
  • Access to a smartphone or camera capable of producing sharp, well-lit photos

Compensation

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Web Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Street Diligence Inc. as a Senior Web Application Engineer, where you will play a key role in architecting and developing high-performance web applications. Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Help conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
  • Help establish robust component libraries and expand object composition

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
  • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
  • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Agile Facilitator
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience as a Scrum Master , acting as the main Agile facilitator for development teams.
  • Solid Business Analysis fundamentals , including requirements gathering, refinement, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Outstanding communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience facilitating local and remote Agile teams .
  • Proven coaching and mentoring capabilities.
  • Strong background promoting Agile mindset, values, and culture .
  • Knowledge of additional Agile frameworks or methods (e.g., Kanban, XP, Lean).
  • Deep experience with refinement, story splitting, estimation, velocity tracking, retrospectives, and other Agile techniques.
  • Good understanding of software development practices such as TDD, BDD, unit testing, test automation, version control, and CI/CD.
  • Advanced English is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary Scrum Master, ensuring Agile values, principles, and practices are consistently applied.
  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies and support effective team decision-making.
  • Coach and mentor Scrum teams to continuously improve delivery, collaboration, and predictability.
  • Partner with the Product Owner to support backlog refinement, prioritization, and clarity of requirements.
  • Apply Business Analysis skills to help translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories when needed.
  • Identify and remove impediments, dependencies, and delivery blockers.
  • Promote cross-team collaboration and eliminate siloed ways of working.
  • Enable data-driven continuous improvement through metrics, insights, and retrospectives.
  • Ensure goals, scope, and priorities are clearly understood across the team.
  • Support effective demos, reviews, and product/system testing activities.
  • Facilitate alignment between technical teams and business stakeholders when challenges arise.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Freelance Photographer
description:
We are seeking skilled and reliable freelance photographers to support an upcoming visual content initiative. This role involves capturing a small set of high-quality images following a general creative brief. Photographers may work with models or self-shoot, depending on preference and availability.

This is a great opportunity for photographers looking to take on flexible contract work, build their portfolio, or collaborate on a unique project.

About the Role

Photographers will be responsible for producing a series of clear, well-lit images that meet the project’s technical and creative guidelines. The work can be completed at your preferred location, using your own equipment. 

No specialized gear is required; modern smartphones or standard photography equipment are both acceptable as long as they meet basic quality expectations. 

Responsabilities

  • Capture a small set of photos following a simple creative brief
  • Ensure images are well-composed and meet general quality standards
  • Work independently and deliver files within the requested timeframe
  • Communicate promptly and professionally throughout the project
  • Provide all required files and any accompanying forms upon completion

Qualifications

  • Experience in photography (professional or amateur)
  • Ability to capture clear, high-quality images
  • Reliable communication and attention to detail
  • Access to a smartphone or camera capable of producing sharp, well-lit photos

Compensation

A competitive payment is provided based on the number of approved submissions. Payments are made once a month.

description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 56624


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / .NET 6+ .
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST , gRPC, WebAPI e boas práticas de design (DDD, SOLID).
  • Experiência com Entity Framework , LINQ , e integração com bancos relacionais (SQL Server) e NoSQL.

  • Padrões de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing).

  • Experiência com ECS/EKS , Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , CloudWatch , RDS/DynamoDB .
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK ).
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, GitLab).


  • DevOps & Qualidade:
  • Integração contínua, pipelines de build/deploy.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).
  • Monitoramento e escalabilidade.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

  • Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento e definição de escopo junto à equipe de projeto.

  • Experiência sólida (mínimo 10 anos ) em SAP EHS ;
  • Conhecimento prático em SAP HCM (Time Management e Payroll) ;
  • Vivência com projetos SAP de médio e grande porte;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% remota.

  • Conhecimento no setor público e/ou setor de águas e saneamento ;

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!
